description: Place an outbound voice call through Twilio. Pass a `to` number (E.164 like +201234567890) and either a `prompt` (the assistant will speak it; recipient response is recorded by default) or raw `twiml` for full control. Returns the Call SID and initial status.

closing_message.description: Optional final line spoken before hangup.

consented.description: Attest that the recipient has given prior express consent (and, where required by law, prior express WRITTEN consent) to receive this AI voice call. Required for destinations in strict-consent jurisdictions (US, UK, EU, AU, NZ). Leave false for permissive jurisdictions (Egypt, UAE, KSA, etc.) — the geo-gate will allow those by default.

language.description: Locale tag matching the voice, e.g. 'en-US', 'ar-EG'.

machine_detection.description: Whether Twilio should detect voicemail. 'DetectMessageEnd' waits for the beep before TwiML runs.

prompt.description: What the assistant should say when the recipient picks up. If `record` is not false, a recording prompt is appended.

record.description: Whether to record the recipient's reply after the prompt. Ignored when `twiml` or `url` is supplied.

status_callback.description: Optional public URL Twilio POSTs to as the call progresses (initiated → ringing → answered → completed).

twiml.description: Inline TwiML XML to use instead of the prompt/record flow. If set, `prompt` is ignored.

url.description: Public URL Twilio fetches for TwiML. Use this only if you need stateful flows. Leave empty to inline TwiML.

voice.description: Twilio TTS voice. e.g. 'Polly.Joanna-Neural' (en-US), 'Polly.Hala-Neural' (ar-EG), 'Polly.Zeina' (ar-MSA), 'Google.en-US-Wavenet-D'. Default Polly.Joanna-Neural.

name: make_call
title: Place a phone call
